what: Capped probes of 2026-11-17 (systemd-run --user --scope -p MemoryMax=4G -p MemorySwapMax=0 timeout 300, one at a time, JDK 25.0.5), each a single run to see where the checker stops on example 307. None is evidence for the claim: a probe answers nothing, and the classes are a hand compile by the slice's recipe (Temurin 8 javac -g -source 1.8 -target 1.8 -encoding UTF-8), not the route's prepared artifacts.
command: jvmcontract equivalence --before BEFORE --after AFTER --target 'org.springframework.security.crypto.bcrypt.BCrypt#hashpw(java.lang.String, java.lang.String)' --nullable password --nullable salt --assume ASSUME --engine native --gaps strict --max-array-length 80 --timeout T --work W --json

classes.recipe: each revision's BCrypt.java from the cached clone of spring-projects/spring-security at the commits target.json names, compiled alone by Temurin 1.8.0_512 javac with the slice's flags; mutant is after with controls/us-ascii.patch's one line; twin is after with hashpw(String,String)'s last statement written as two (String hashed = hashpw(passwordb, salt); return hashed;), a pair constructed only to reach the cipher on both sides

stream.what: the preservation stream's last commit before its I010 fix, rmvpqswzxlyv (git e461ac1d2c5f), lib/ exported and built apart with cargo build --release

prototype.what: the same with lib/tests/fixtures/conversion-countermodels/prototype-model.patch applied (String.getBytes("UTF-8") and the US-ASCII conversion modelled)

probes.problem: outside the fragment: java.lang.String.getBytes on an object the engine does not model
probes.reading: The first stop of the claim's own pair: the previous revision's password.getBytes("UTF-8"). The nullable String parameters (VF-028) are no longer refused, and the claim's assume expression compiles.

probes.problem: outside the fragment: reads static field java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets.US_ASCII, which is not a compile-time constant
probes.reading: The first stop of the mutation pair: the mutant's read of StandardCharsets.US_ASCII, on the path of a null password, before any cipher. The mutant's conversion needs a model of its own before the task can be refuted under --gaps strict.

probes.verdict: none: killed at the memory cap
probes.problem: the kernel's OOM killer, 4G peak after 62 s
probes.reading: Past the conversion, at the claim's unwind 513 every loop of bcrypt is within the bound, so none is summarized and nothing is tied: the checker unwinds the key schedule itself and runs out of memory. This is the cost of the cipher alone; both sides convert with the modelled getBytes(UTF_8).

probes.unwind: the checker's default (16): a trial, not the claim's bound
probes.problem: the engine did not finish within the time limit
probes.reading: With loops summarized past unwind 16 the ties apply (36,061 tied, 72 summaries taken over) and the run still ends at the time limit, 203 of 240 s in the solver: the same cost profile as 287 at bound 80.

probes.verdict: none: killed at the memory cap
probes.problem: the kernel's OOM killer, 4G peak after 39 s
probes.reading: The second stop of the claim's own pair, once the named conversion is modelled: the cipher under complete unwinding. Nothing else stood between the conversion and bcrypt (Arrays.copyOf, Integer.parseInt, StringBuilder and the base64 helpers are passed).

probes.problem: the engine did not finish within the time limit
probes.reading: No witness within the limit: the search spends its time in the same summaries, and does not get a candidate from the differing bytes before it.
